name: Battle

components.pose: She slams her totem staff down with one hand and sweeps the other arm up, the ground heaving beneath her, hair and fringe flying, a fierce gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.headwear: a feather crown on a bronze headband
components.jewelry: {{ACCENT_SOFT}} bead necklaces with bone and {{METAL}} talismans, heavy bronze cuffs
components.effects: The earth splits and slabs of stone heave up into a wall in front of her, dust and boulders hurled through the air, {{MAGIC}} light running through the cracks.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
